Commentary.Commentary: We hope you enjoyed our coverage of the entire series. We surely loved having you. And we hope you join us for further matches, and get excited, folks, because there are going to be plenty of them. Till then, take care of yourselves and stay safe. Goodbye and take care!

Right, then! So that's it from us. We've finally come to an end of a long yet entertaining battle between these two teams. It was first in the Tests, and now in the limited overs format, and in both, Australia have come out on top. They will be quite happy with themselves after having a disappointing summer. Pakistan on the other hand, have positives to take from this and can take it as a learning experience. They now know where their weakness lies, and can work upon it.

Australia skipper, Steven Smith says they have played some good cricket over the last two games. Applauds David Warner for his performances but gives a special mention to Travis Head for the way he played today. States that after the disappointment against South Africa, it took a lot of efforts from his boys to come back stronger so is happy that all the hard work paid off. Hopes that they can do well in New Zealand and thinks of it as a great challenge for his side before they travel to India. Ends by thanking the crowd and Pakistan for the way they played over the last couple of months.

Man of the Match and Series, David Warner says it is good fun winning the Allan Border Trophy during the week and come back out again to play good cricket throughout. On his dropped catch when he was on 0, says that you shouldn't look back and keep playing good cricket as it is a part of the game and admits that it feels good to be lucky twice. When asked about being rested for the NZ tour, states that he is happy to get that. Ends by saying that it was a good innings and hopes to play positive cricket in the future as well.

Pakistan skipper, Azhar Ali says today again it was a tough total to chase. Credits Warner and Head for the way they batted and took them out of the game. On the toss, he chuckles and mentions that it's just part of the game and you can't really do much about that. Adds that the toss doesn't matter as good teams play well and perform regardless of that. Thanks Cricket Australia and the crowd for their support.

Pakistan really needed to get off to a flying start. They lost their skipper early but Sharjeel Khan and Babar Azam took things under control. They threaded a partnership of 130 runs but once that was broken, it was all but over for them. The southpaw went on to score a good 50 while Babar made a beautiful ton. The visiting side however fell short as the target was too big to chase down. Mitchell Starc was the most successful bowler as he took a 4-fer, while his fellow bowlers contributed and played their part.

An emphatic win for Australia as they have thumped Pakistan in this match and have won the series 4-1. They were right on top of this match the moment it started and there was no looking back for them from there. David Warner and Travis Head got the ball rolling and completely took the game away from the visitors with their record 284-run partnership. Both scored terrific centuries and were sublime. Wickets fell later but by then it was a little too late.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Superb yorker, right on the money. Riaz cannot get his bat down in time as the ball sneaks through and rattles the timber. As Shoaib Malik won't come back to bat, it ends the Pakistan innings. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 57 RUNS.
Junaid Khan is next in.

OUT! Tossed up and Ali comes down the track and goes for a slog. He is totally beaten by the spin and the ball goes straight to the keeper. Wade who was waiting for such an opportunity gathers the ball and rips the bails off.
On the pads, Riaz goes for a slog but manages to get it towards short fine leg for a single with his inner half of the bat.
Shorter delivery, Riaz tries to pull it but is unable to make contact there.
Ali lofts the floated delivery over covers for a single.

SIX! FREE GIFTS! Full toss on the stumps and Ali has thrown his bat at it and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie. That's gone just over the ropes. A fielder tries to pull it in but it goes sailing over his head.
Down the leg side, Ali goes for a sweep but misses and the ball hits the pads.
Fuller ball and Riaz swings hard at it but misses.
In the air...safe! Ali goes for a slog but mistimes it and the ball goes just over the fielder at covers for a single.

DROPPED! Length ball outside off, Riaz drives it uppishly over point. The ball goes straight to the deep point fielder. Zampa dives forward and is not able to hold onto it as a chance goes abegging. They run a single in the process.
FOUR! WHACKED! Fuller on the stumps, Riaz whacks it straight down the ground through mid off for a boundary.
Full on the stumps, Riaz has gone hard at it but managed to just loft it over the mid on fielder for a couple.
Full on the pads, Hasan tries to flick it but the ball hits the pads and goes on the on side for a single.
Fuller delivery on the stumps, Ali drives it through mid on to keep strike.
On the pads, Riaz flicks it on the on side for a single.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. They pick up a single.
Short into the body, Riaz pulls it wide of long on for a single.
Slower delivery again on the stumps, Hasan clips it on the on side for a single.
Slower delivery on the pads, Riaz sits and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full toss outside off, Hasan Ali gets an edge which goes through the keeper. Two runs taken.
Fullish in length outside off, Riaz carves it over the point region and picks up a single for doing so.
Fuller outside off, Wahab looks to drive but misses.
That was really close. Starc continues to use the angles, fires it in on a full length. It just whiskers past the off pole.
Full and angling in from around off, straightens up after hitting the deck, Wahab plays and misses.
Comes from around the wicket and angles in a full ball on middle and off, Wahab Riaz meets it with a straight blade and keeps it out.
Mitchell Starc back into the attack.
Fuller on the stumps, Riaz lofts it over mid off for a single.
Outside off on good length, Riaz cuts it through point for a couple.
WIDE! Short and way outside off, Riaz goes after this one but misses. Umpire signals it a wide.
Hasan Ali will be next in.

OUT! Slower delivery which is bowled from back of his hand. Wahab stays deep and goes for a slog and the ball catches the top edge and balloons in the air. The ball goes straight to the fielder at covers for an easy catch.
Back of a length delivery, Amir punches it through covers for a couple.
Slower one outside off, Amir swings and misses.
A proper tailender's sweep there. Riaz sweeps it on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, Riaz drives it through covers for a single.
The batsman does well to loft that over the slip region. They pick up a single.
On the pads, Wahab goes to hit it and the ball hits low on his pads. The ball goes towards mid-wicket and they run a single. Leg bye given.
Wahab Riaz comes out to bat.

OUT! THE AKMAL SHOW COMES TO AN END! Wide and full outside off, Akmal goes to reach at it and gets an outside edge. The ball goes straight in the hands of the keeper. Wade won't miss those. Is it over for Pakistan?
Akmal plays a square cut, goes to run a single but then retreats. The fielder at point was quick to react but luckily it did not hit the stumps.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Akmal drives it uppishly over the mid off fielder for a boundary. That was delightful to the eyes.
SIX! MASSIVE! Short delivery just outside off, Amir free his arms and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. That would be a six on any ground.
Full on the stumps, Amir has fiercely hit it down towards the mid on fielder.
FOUR! Full length delivery on the stumps, Amir makes room and whacks it over the cover region for a boundary. Amir gets into the act.
Length delivery outside off, Amir pushes it towards the cover fielder.

Good length delivery into the stumps, Amir pulls it towards the mid-wicket region and runs a quick single. The fielder at mid-wicket has a shy at the stumps and that helps them run an extra run on overthrow due to poor covering.
Good length delivery outside off, Akmal nudges it to the cover region for a quick single.
Amir stays deep in his crease and defends the length ball.
Slower full toss tad outside off, Akmal pushes it through covers for a single.
Steaming delivery outside off, Akmal tries to poke at it but cannot make contact.
FOUR! Wide outside off, Akmal throws his bat at it and the ball flies off the outside edge towards right of the keeper for a boundary.
FOUR! SMOKED! Length delivery angling into the batsman, Akmal whacks it over the mid-wicket region for the boundary. Can Akmal pull out something special?
Slower delivery which was dug in short, Akmal goes for a pull but is totally foxed by the speed.
Outside off on a length, easily run down to third man for one run. Pakistan need 120 runs to win off 54 balls.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Back of a length outside off, it's sliced to third man for a single.
Plays it off the outer half of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single.
Beaten again! On a good length, seaming away, Amir throws his bat at this but fails to make any connection.
Length delivery angling across the batsman, Amir looks to hit it through the off side but misses.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. That will allow Australia to have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle.
Mohammad Amir is the next batsman in.

OUT! RIZWAN HAS TO WALK BACK! Back of a length delivery outside off, Rizwan cuts it uppishly towards third man. Starc who is fielding there dives forward for a sensational catch. He is not quite sure if he has gathered it cleanly or not. The umpires go upstairs to check the catch. Replays show that it was a clean catch and Starc has pulled it off spectacularly well.

Mohammad Rizwan has been caught by Mitchell Starc at third man. He dived forward and took it just inches above the ground. The umpires aren't sure if it's taken cleanly or not so it is taken upstairs. The soft signal is out.
Short into the body, Rizwan goes for a pull but top edges towards fine leg for a couple.
Short ball outside off, Akmal guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! LUCKY ONE! Length ball outside off, Akmal swings his bat wildly and the ball flies off the thick outside edge over the point region for a boundary. He was nowhere in control of that shot.
Slower delivery and that's foxed Akmal completely. He goes across and tries to slog it over the mid-wicket region but is unable to make contact.
Dug in short and perfectly on the body, Rizwan hops and defends it on the on side for a quick single.
Pat Cummins will have a go with the ball again.
Full on the stumps, it's driven back to Hazlewood. He does well to get low and throw it back at the striker's end quickly.
FOUR! Akmal is finding the boundary more frequently now. Full on leg, Umar picks it off his pads and chips it over wide mid on for the second boundary of the over.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, Umar Akmal swings his bat across the line but doesn't connect well. It's in the air for a while but still falls safely. Two taken.
Ripper from Hazlewood! He bowls this on an excellent length in that off stump channel, straightens up ever so slightly and beats the outside edge of Umar Akmal's bat.
FOUR! Short and that's put away. Umar Akmal gets into position early and pulls it over the square leg region to send it across the fence.
Length ball outside off, maybe a little fuller, it's driven back down towards mid off. Warner cuts it off and quickly fires a throw at the keeper's end. A single is taken.
Wide! Fired down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
On the pads, Rizwan clips it towards square leg for a single.

DROPPED! Fuller on the stumps, Akmal stays in his crease and checks his shot. He mistimes it towards long on. Handscomb the fielder there, dives to his left but cannot hold onto the ball. This catch could have ended the match quickly but they get a single in this process.
Shorter into the body, Rizwan waits for it and guides it towards third man for a single.
On the pads, Akmal clips it on the on side for a single.
Again short this time outside off, Akmal cuts it towards the player at point.
Back of a length, dabbed towards backward point.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Length delivery moving away, it's dabbed to point for no run.
Steven Smith comes in at first slip...
Wide! Fractionally fuller in length and going away from the batsman, outside off, looks to push at it but misses.
Mohammad Rizwan in the new man in.

OUT! Babar Azam departs! That's a big, big wicket for Australia. Fuller and slower on the stumps, Babar closes the face a little too early and gets a leading edge which lobs towards mid on. Travis Head is the man there and he takes the simplest of catches. A superb knock has come to an end.
Length ball outside off, a play and a miss.
Attacks the stumps this time, it's hit towards mid on for one run.
4th ODI ton for Babar Azam!

Century for Babar Azam! Wonderful knock from the youngster. He hangs back and turns it to mid-wicket for a single. Raises his bat to his dressing room but he knows he has to carry on. The job is only half done.
Wide! Length delivery well outside off, seaming away a bit, Babar goes after it but misses. Wide called. Hazlewood is not happy.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl now.
On the shorter side, it's kept out off the back foot in front of covers. A quick single is taken. He's on 99 now.
FOUR! Make that three in a row! Babar Azam is powering towards a ton. Slower and fuller outside off, he squeezes it past point for another boundary. On 98 now.
FOUR! Two in two for Babar! He gets this on the pads and he's happy as a duck. Flicks it through backward square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Babar Azam cuts it past backward point and picks up a boundary.
Slower one outside off, it's a fuller in length as Babar slams this to Warner at mid off.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, it's worked to mid-wicket for one.
Short around off, pulled to mid-wicket for nothing.
Shortish and pitched outside off, comfortably guided down to third man for one run.
Bangs it in short, Akmal goes for a pull but misses as it is too high for him. Could have easily been called a wide.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Back of a length outside off, steered towards backward point where Steven Smith makes a good stop.
Length ball outside off, Babar stands firm and lofts it over mid off. Doesn't get all of it but it's enough to fetch him two runs. 200 up for Pakistan.
FOUR! Too straight and it's put away, Akmal tucks it behind square on the leg side and ends the over with a boundary.
A bit short and slanting away outside off, cut away through point for one.
Pitches it up there once more, Babar Azam drives this back down the track. Faulkner is alert to this and he reacts quickly to stop the ball from going past him.
Fullish outside off, it's hit through the cover region for one easy run.
Some extra bounce from Faulkner. He bowls this on a length, on the stumps, takes Umar by surprise and catches his on the thigh pad again.
Length ball on middle and leg, coming in, Akmal looks to slog it over the leg side but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
James Faulkner returns to bowl.
Short ball on off, Babar Azam gets big on the bounce and pulls it with great control past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a couple of runs.
Angling in sharply on a back of a length, catches him on the thigh pad as he attempts to play at it.
Wide! Banged in short and going down leg, wide called.
Akmal comes down to play in from inside the line but gets an edge which flies towards backward point.
Good length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, Babar guides it to third man and picks up a single.
Shortish on the body, pulled through square leg for a single.
Short of a length delivery in that off stump channel, Umar Akmal looks to poke at it but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Brings his wrists into play and turns this through backward square leg. Single to end the over.
Another pull but this time it's through mid-wicket. Babar Azam stands tall and gets it in the gap. Another single.
Coming in on middle and leg, it's pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery around off, Umar Akmal gets behind the line and blocks it with a straight blade.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length on the body, it's worked through backward square leg for a brace.

CHANCE OF A RUN OUT! Umar Akmal was in no man's land and he was almost gone, without even troubling the scorers. He taps this length ball on the leg side. Cummins charges to the ball as Akmal sets off for some reason. Pat has a shy at the striker's end and just misses. Had he hit, Umar was out of here. He was way outside his crease and wouldn't have made it back.

So, it has become clear now what part the ball went off. Seems Shoaib Malik was caught on the left forearm and he's felt the pressure on his wrist. He earlier suffered a blow on his wrists as well during fielding. He's walking off the field now. That's not a good sign but hopefully it's not too serious. So, Umar Akmal will be taking his place now out in the middle.
Drinks break!

Shortish ball jagging back in to Shoaib Malik, he is caught by surprise and the ball catches some part of him. Not sure what though but it lobs behind to Smith at first slip who takes the catch. The umpire remains unmoved though, so no bat involvement there I guess.
On a good length and pitched outside off, run down to third man for one.
On the shorter side, Babar Azam fends it away through mid-wicket. It's in the gap and so, another two runs are taken.
Quite fuller outside off, Azam with a drive to sweeper cover. Two runs are taken.
Wide! Cummins brings out the short one and bangs the deck hard, Babar keeps his eyes on the ball and lets it sail over him. Wide signalled for height.
Fullish in length and it's driven towards mid on by Babar Azam.
Pat Cummins back on to bowl.
Short ball on middle and off, it climbs on Shoaib Malik a bit too quickly and he gets a top edge on his pull shot. It flies towards fine leg and two runs are taken.
Length ball outside off, Shoaib Malik with an angled bat runs it to the right of Smith at first slip. He dives to his right and makes the stop.
Short of a length around off, Babar swivels across and pulls it along the ground through square leg for a single.

SIX! SHOT! Babar Azam picked up the length early and dispatched that. Fuller in length, he stands his ground and slogs it over wide long on for a biggie. He's the set batsman, somebody has to take the risks now.
Back of a length outside off, it's dabbed towards backward point for a quick single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tight line from Josh. Shoaib hangs back and punches it through cover-point for a double.
Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack.
Fired full outside off, it's drilled back down the ground for a brisk single.
Plays this a little squarer than Babar. Gets it in the gap and picks up two for it.
Babar Azam has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Pitches it up there to Shoaib Malik, it's driven through to sweeper cover for one run.
Just back of a length, slanting across, it's punched through the covers for a single.
Wide! Going down leg, wide signalled.

FOUR! That's poor. Not what you'd expect from the Aussie players. Length ball outside off, Azam drives it a bit square through backward point. Handscomb runs to his left from sweeper cover, gets low to collect it but lets it go through his palms. Probably a slight lapse in concentration.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Loopy leg spinner around off, driven to wide long off for one.
Short and wide outside off, punched square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Makes great use of his feet, gets to the pitch and eases it down to long off for a single.
Floats it up on the stumps, Azam drives it back in the direction of the bowler.
FOUR! Great shot by Babar Azam. Adjusts his body well, opens it up a bit and goes inside out. Lofts it over covers and beats the fielder out in the deep. Boundary to start the over.
An accurate bumper on middle and off, watchfully ducked and evaded to end the over.
Full and angling across outside off, Shoaib drives it square straight to the man at point.
Excellent length delivery from Mitchell Starc, shaping away a touch on middle and off, Shoaib Malik positions himself perfectly behind the line and defends.
Shoaib Malik is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Edged and taken! Bringing the slip in place was genius captaincy. Starc uses the angle well, bowls it across Mohammad Hafeez, on a back of a length, The Professor hangs his bat out to it and gets a healthy edge. Easily taken by Steven Smith at first slip. Pakistan lose another wicket.
Spears in a full ball, attempting the inswinging yorker, it's driven back out to the bowler.
Good length delivery around off, there's some extra bounce off the surface as Hafeez keeps it out from within his crease.
Outside off, it's played square of the wicket on the off side. Single taken.
Tossed up, another drive to mid off for a single.
Mohammad Hafeez comes ahead to this flighted delivery and drives it through mid off for a run.
7th ODI fifty for Babar Azam!
Lovely knock from Babar Azam. He brings up his fifty in a solid manner. Confidently pushes it to the covers and gets a run to reach the milestone.
Full around off, Babar is hit on the pads as he tries to drive but not before taking the inside edge. Hence, the leg before shouts have been shut down.
Tossed up on middle and off, Hafeez leans ahead and eases it down towards mid off for a single.
Starc once again brings out the short one, it's ducked and evaded.
On the fullish side, it's driven to mid on for no run.
Mohammad Hafeez walks into the middle next.

OUT! That's gone high in the air and Sharjeel Khan is out of here! Matthew Wade takes an excellent catch. Mitchell Starc gets the breakthrough, as he has done so often for Australia over the years. Banged in short on middle and off, Khan rocks back and goes for the big pull but gets a big top edge. It skies towards short fine leg where Wade runs under it and takes it in his gloves. That's a big wicket and the 130-run stand it finally broken.
The batsman has dug out that yorker at the last second. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slants is across the right-hander, Babar Azam looks to put bat on ball but fails to do so.
Full delivery just outside off, Babar drives it straight back to the bowler.
Flatter this time, Sharjeel pushes it back to the bowler.
Mitchell Starc returns to the attack.
Shorter this time, Sharjeel pushes this one towards long on for a single.
Down the leg side, Sharjeel clips it towards square leg for a single.
Azam pushes it towards the cover region for a single.
Shorter down the leg side, Sharjeel clips it towards square leg for a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, BA camps back and punches it towards long off for a single.
Bit fullish in length, outside off, pushed to cover-point for a single.
Full outside off, it's driven through to sweeper cover for a comfortable run.
Cramping him for room once more, but Babar Azam does well to swat it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length delivery just around off, it's kept out off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, Babar Azam is a little cramped for room as he cuts that away. It's straight to the fielder at point.
Fuller delivery outside off, Babar drives it past the bowler for no run.

SIX! GONE THE DISTANCE! Tossed up on the stumps, Sharjeel removes his front leg out of his way and bangs it over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen. That ball was a six from the moment it left the bat.
Shorter this time outside off, Babar cuts it through covers for a single.
Tossed up on the pads, Sharjeel sweeps it towards backward square leg for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT! Tossed up outside off, Sharjeel drives it straight back to the bowler. Zampa goes for the catch and he gets his fingers to it before hitting the stumps. They go upstairs to check if Babar Azam is outside the line. Replays show that he was well in line this time and he is safe.
Australia go upstairs for  a run out appeal against Babar Azam.
SIX! THAT'S GONE INTO SPACE! Tossed up and Sharjeel has picked the bones out of it and thrown it in the stands. He has just hoisted that over the mid-wicket region for a maximum. Top shot.
Back of a length outside off, Babar just cuts it behind point.
Full on the stumps, Sharjeel drives it down the ground for a single towards long on.
On the pads, Azam flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and into the batsmen, Azam punches it towards mid on.
Wide and full outside off, Sharjeel slaps it wide of mid off with power. Warner fields it well and they pick up a single.
Angling into the stumps, Babar clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
James Faulkner is brought back into the attack.
Down the leg side, Khan sweeps it towards short fine leg.
Outside off, Azam pushes it through covers for a single.
Width on offer and Azam cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Short delivery, Azam defends it off his back foot.
Floated outside off, Azam drives it through covers. Starc cuts it off at the boundary ropes and keeps it to two.
On the pads, Sharjeel goes for a sweep but misses and gets an inside edge which tickles the ball through the short fine leg region. The fielder saves the boundary but they run three.
Short and outside off, cut through to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated around off, it's driven to covers. One run taken.
Flatter and shorter outside off, cut away square on the off side for one run.
FOUR! Flat, short and coming in with the arm, Sharjeel rocks back and muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted delivery from Travis Head, it's eased down to long on for a run.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up there, Sharjeel Khan lofts it down to long off for a single.
Sharjeel brings the wrists into play and works it on the leg side for a single.
Loops it up around the off pole, it's driven to long off for a run.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Slips it down the leg side, Sharjeel misses his shot and Wade misses to collect. The batsmen take a run and wide is signalled as well.
Loopy and fullish in length, around off, driven to long off for one.
Floats this on a driving length, outside off, Babar Azam leans ahead to drive it but gets an inside edge down the leg side.
Turning away on a flatter length, outside off, punched off the back foot.
Floated outside off, Azam drives it straight to mid on for a single.
6th ODI fifty for Sharjeel Khan!
Tossed up, Sharjeel drives it towards mid off for a single. That shot gets him to his fifty. He will need a big innings to keep the visitors in the game.
On the pads, Azam clips it towards square leg for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Shorter outside off, Sharjeel punches it towards wide of long off for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Khan cuts it towards the point fielder.
Travis Head comes into the attack now.
Worked away on the leg side to keep the strike.
FOUR! In the air...Safe! Just over the top this time as Sharjeel lofts it over the mid off fielder. Hazlewood at mid off jumps but cannot get it and the ball races away towards the boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shorter this time, Sharjeel pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up, Babar drives it through mid off for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Azam punches it off the back foot towards the cover region for a single. A diving fielder saves the boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Sharjeel guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Just a tad bit outside off, on a good length, Sharjeel punches it through the point region for a boundary. He has his own book of shots.
Short and wide outside off, Sharjeel tries the upper cut but cannot make contact.
Short and into the body, Azam pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Sharjeel guides it towards third man for a single.
Drinks has been taken.
Floated up, Azam lunges forward and defends it towards the cover region.
Tossed up outside off, Azam slices it through the point region for a couple.
Azam camps back and defends it.
Down the leg side, Sharjeel clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Khan drives it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on the stumps, Sharjeel defends it.
Adam Zampa comes in for a bowl. So it's spin now.
A bit shorter outside off, Azam defends it with soft hands towards the point region and thinks of a single. But Sharjeel sends him back.
Angling into the stumps, Babar tries to clip it on the leg side but finds a leading edge going towards the cover fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, Azam stays in his crease and defends that one.
Back of a length on the pads, Sharjeel clips it through square leg for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.

FOUR! He alerts all the photographers with that elegant drive. Full delivery on the stumps, Azam drives it straight down the ground for a boundary through the mid on region. Maybe the best shot of this innings.
FOUR! Short into the stumps, Khan pulls it through the square leg region for a boundary. Unorthodox but effective.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
50-run stand between Sharjeel and Azam!
Short on the pads, Azam flicks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! SUBLIME! Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam cuts it through the cover region to elegantly get a boundary through the off side.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Azam shuffles and pushes it straight back to the bowler.
Short ball outside off, Sharjeel cuts it through point for a single.
Dug in short, Azam ducks under it.
Short into the pads, Azam gets on his toes and flicks it towards square leg for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Azam pushes it through the cover region. Warner gives it a chase and dives to save the boundary. Two runs saved there.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam guides it towards the fielder at backward point.
Good length delivery, nips back a bit. Azam tries to defend but the ball goes straight to the keeper.
Short and outside off, Azam stands tall and defends it.
FOUR! STAND AND DELIVER! Fuller on the stumps, Sharjeel stays in his crease and just flicks it with power over the mid-wicket region. This man has power in his hands.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam rides it across through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, Azam drives it towards the cover fielder.
Angling across from a length, Azam goes for a drive but finds an inside edge which hits his pads.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam defends it solidly.
Short to start off with, Sharjeel pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
James Faulkner will replace Josh Hazlewood in the attack.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman

NOT OUT! Full delivery on the stumps, Sharjeel drives it straight down the ground. Cummins gets his hand to it and deflects it to the stumps. The ball goes towards mid on after hitting the stumps. Sharjeel was nearly at the non-striker's end for a run and was then sent back by Babar. Now they appeal for a run-out at the non-striker's end but makes it back in time. He just got back in time and the throw was not at the stumps.
Australia go up for a run out appeal against Babar Azam at the non-striker's end.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharjeel pushes it towards the left of mid off for a single. Warner has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharjeel defends it with soft hands on the off side and picks up a quick single.
Length delivery on the stumps, Sharjeel defends it by getting behind the line of the delivery.
Pat Cummins comes in for a bowl.
In the air.....safe! Short delivery into the body, Sharjeel goes for the pull shot but top edges it. The ball flies towards fine leg. The fielder running behind from short fine leg cannot reach it.
Good length delivery outside off, Sharjeel tries to cut it but misses.
FOUR! Width on offer and Sharjeel punishes him. Short outside off, Sharjeel whacks it past point for a boundary.
Short delivery into the body, Sharjeel half pulls it through wide mid on for a couple.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Half-volley outside off, Sharjeel just follows his drive with his big bat lift as the ball races away through the cover region for a boundary.
Length ball on the stumps, Sharjeel opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man.
Fullish delivery outside off, Azam drives it elegantly down the ground. Warner at mid off makes a diving effort to stop the ball. No run taken.
Short and angling across outside off, Azam tries to cut it but is unable to make contact.
Angled into the pads, Sharjeel flicks it towards mid on for a single.
Yorker on the stumps, Sharjeel pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Short into the body, Sharjeel short arm jabs it towards the mid-wicket region. That's another boundary for the southpaw.
Full length delivery, Azam drives it through extra cover for a single.
Fullish length delivery outside off, Azam tries to poke it but catches the outside edge which goes towards third man for a single.
Again a good length delivery, Azam stays in his crease and defends that one.
Good length delivery, Azam punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Azam tries to clip it but is unable to make contact. Wide is signaled.
Again a similar delivery and Azam drives it in the V. That ball goes towards mid off.
Length ball on the stumps, Azam drives it towards mid on.
Full outside off, Sharjeel drives it towards the fielder at point.
Short into the body, Sharjeel tries to clip it on the on side but misses. The ball hits him on the thigh pad.
Short into the body, Sharjeel gets cramped for room as he tries to flick it and he gets hit on the pads.
Short delivery and Sharjeel pulls it on the on side.
Low full toss angling into the pads, Azam has worked it down the leg side through mid-wicket for a triple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! WIDTH AND DRIVEN! Length ball outside off, Sharjeel drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Fullish on the stumps, Sharjeel keeps it at bay.

Shout for an lbw! Angling around the pads, Sharjeel tries to defend it but is unable to make contact. He gets hit low on his pads and the players appeal in unison. The umpire says not out and the replays show that it pitched outside leg.
Length ball outside off, Sharjeel has punched that back straight to the bowler.
Full delivery outside off, Azam drives it down the ground through mid on for a triple.
Wide outside off, Azam stays undisturbed in his crease.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Azam has let that through.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Babar drives the full ball outside off towards mid off.
Babar Azam comes out next.

OUT! STARC STRIKES! Azhar was looking vulnerable since the first ball and his short term in the middle comes to an end. Inswinging full delivery into the pads, Ali cannot get his bat down in time and the ball hits his pads. The players appeal and it's plumb says the umpire as he is fast to raise his finger up.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Ali somehow manages to put bat to it as he drives it past the point region for a boundary.
Low full toss this time, Ali drives it towards mid on.
NASTY! Steamy full toss on the stumps, Azhar gets an inside edge and gets hit hard on the thighs. That might have hurt him hard and he is down on his haunches.
Sharjeel tries to drive the ball outside off, he is totally beaten due to the movement of the ball as that ball nipped in a bit.
Length ball angling across, cuts straight towards the fielder at covers.
Good length outside off, Sharjeel tries to cut it but he cannot make contact.
Fuller outside off, Ali drives it through the mid off region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off which nips away after pitching, Azhar tries to defend it but the ball moves away past to the keeper.
On a goodish length outside off, left alone.
Josh Hazlewood will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Play and a miss! Full and outside off, Khan tries to drive but the ball nips away to beat the outside edge.
Short ball not rising much, Khan is early into the shot and hence misses. He takes a blow on his chest but doesn't show much pain.
Short again, angling in and cramping the batsman for room, Sharjeel somehow gets it away with a pull shot over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, a touch short, Sharjeel tries to pull but misses.
Outside off, Khan pushes inside the line and misses.
On the pads, Sharjeel goes for a flick on the on side and he misses. The ball hits him low on his pads.
Length delivery outside off, Azhar punches it on the up through the cover region for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, AA goes for a flick but misses. The umpire has signaled it a wide.

So we are ready for the chase and so are the players. They are out in the middle. Azhar Ali and Sharjeel Khan will open for Pakistan. Mitchell Starc will start the proceedings with the ball for Australia.
